description: BC Wildfire CRI Fuel Treatments is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by BC Wildfire Service. Compilation of operational fuel management data provided to BC Wildfire but managed through the the Community Resiliency Investment (CRI) program. For more information (including net treatment info or documents) contact the Fire Centre, Local Government or First Nations Band. Polygons in this data may overlap. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher BC Wildfire Service. Its tags are BCWS, CRI, CWPP, CWRP, SWPI. It offers 5 resource(s) in HTML, KML, MULTIPLE, OTHER, WMS. The portal shows 2026-08-12 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
